description: Aerial or satellite image providing a detailed view of a glacier landscape, specifically representing Glacier (6.3.3.1) de Bossons in the French Alps. The image displays extensive white areas corresponding to glaciers and perpetual snow, interspersed with deep blue water bodies, likely glacial lakes or meltwater. Surrounding these features are exposed areas of bare earth or rock, visible in reddish-brown and dark teal tones. This image serves as a visual example for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Cover / Land Use (LCLU) category 6.3.3.1, "Glaciers and perpetual snow."
